idle.note: the hero's cut-out bob, hunched: torso (with mantle and thorns), hood and both free arms drop 2 px and return as one rigid group; pelvis, tatters, legs and feet still

move.note: a hunched shuffle on the stride/trailing pattern: the stride foot lifts 7 px (the hunch already bends the stance knee, so the swing must bend more), the pelvis is at rest height at each swing apex and dips 2 px after each landing, the claws sway, the leaf tatters trail 2 px

thornwall.note: rears back raising both claws high, then plunges them down to the floor ahead as the bramble wall erupts (contact); holds, claws dug in; rises

lash.note: whips the near claw back and up, then snaps it forward and down at the target (contact; the thorn lash flies); the far claw swings back as a counterweight

mend.note: draws both claws up to its chest and bows its hood, then presses them down and out toward the floor as roots reach the ally (contact); holds; eases back

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 4 degrees, both hands trail 1 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: sags forward into a heap of leaves: the pelvis drops 18 px, the torso pitches forward 25 degrees, the hood drops, the claws fall to the floor ahead, the tatters settle; terminal pose held, then the existing fade
